concerns.text: The cited OpenNeuro resources are parquet shards (e.g., `https://huggingface.co/datasets/clane9/openneuro-fslr64k/…/test-00000-of-00016.parquet`) that contain only curated BIDS metadata, not the raw NIfTI fMRI volumes required for ROI extraction, GLM fitting, and realistic noise estimation. Using these files as the primary fMRI data makes the dataset inappropriate for the intended statistical power analysis, which relies on voxel‑wise BOLD time‑series. Replace the citations with URLs to the full OpenNeuro BIDS datasets (e.g., the original `https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds000030` download) or ensure the referenced resources include the complete functional imaging files.
